rules.rule: cut the final line or two when they restate, moralize or tie a bow on a point already made. end on the last concrete beat or the main takeaway
rules.evidence: 9 pairs (5, 9, 14, 15, 17, 19, 21, 40, 41). pair 17 cuts 'most coaches are paying for traffic and sending it to a website that cannot hold a room'; pair 15 cuts 'the work you put into your offer deserves a website that can hold the weight of it'

rules.rule: remove 'not x' / 'no x' lines and list items that pad a point. keep at most the strongest one or two
rules.evidence: 9 pairs (14, 15, 16, 20, 32, 33, 40, 43, 46). pair 14 cuts 'not the one that feels good'; pair 32 cuts 'no pressure no guilt no negotiation'; pair 40 cuts 'not because i'm special'

rules.rule: add one short, casual aside in his own voice, usually after a point or at the very end, e.g. btw, aka, anyways, couldnt be me, its binary
rules.evidence: 8 pairs (4, 8, 10, 23, 38, 39, 44, 46). pair 8 adds 'that's evolutionary' after 'anything moving beats still text'; pair 46 ends with 'its binary'; pair 39 adds 'couldnt be me'

rules.rule: cut extra detail lines or trailing clauses that elaborate beyond the point of the story, such as side details, aftermath and stacked examples
rules.evidence: 7 pairs (1, 3, 4, 15, 26, 30, 36). pair 3 cuts 'and search runs on the server now so it still finds everything'; pair 36 cuts 'the meeting was fine / got through the work'; pair 15 cuts 'stock photos generic layout copy that sounded like it was written by a committee of nobodies'

rules.rule: write general truths and what visitors or buyers do in the present tense, not the past
rules.evidence: 5 pairs (1, 5, 6, 7, 8). pair 6: 'your visitors only ever saw one' becomes 'your visitors only ever see one'; pair 8: 'the owner paid for that widget' becomes 'the owner pays for that widget'

rules.rule: do not attach specific years to dated-looking examples. use a generic description instead
rules.evidence: 3 pairs (35, 37, 46). pair 35: 'a stock photo from 2017' becomes 'loaded slow'; pair 37: '2019 squarespace template' becomes 'squarespace template'

rules.rule: when a line says 'x not y', break it into two separate lines so the contrast sits on its own line
rules.evidence: 3 pairs (20, 24, 25). pair 25: 'the website was INVISIBLE not broken' becomes 'INVISIBLE' / 'not broken'; pair 24: 'who they were not who they are' becomes 'who they were in the past' / 'not who they are now'
